title: Automatic Tensor-level Execution of Abstract Interpreters for Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2507.20055v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Developing new abstract interpretation-based DNN certifiers is difficult because their mathematical design is expressed at the neuron level, while implementations must operate at the tensor level. Existing libraries such as auto_LiRPA, IVAN, and ERAN support fixed sets of certifiers; extending them requires expertise in formal methods and tensor programming. Domain-specific languages such as ConstraintFlow let researchers specify certifiers at the neuron level, but cannot run them on real DNNs.   We present Neuton, a framework that automatically translates neuron-level certifier specifications into tensor-level executables, enabling new DNN certifiers without manual tensor programming. Neuton makes three contributions. First, a stack-based intermediate representation (IR) and shape analysis infer implicit tensor operations, including broadcasts, dimension expansions, and reductions, required for correct execution. translated_abstract: 开发新的基于抽象解释的深度神经网络（DNN）认证器十分困难，因为其数学设计是在神经元级别表达的，而实现必须在张量级别进行。现有的库（如auto_LiRPA、IVAN和ERAN）仅支持固定的认证器集合；扩展它们需要形式化方法和张量编程方面的专业知识。诸如ConstraintFlow等领域特定语言虽然允许研究人员在神经元级别规范认证器，但无法在真实的DNN上运行。我们提出了Neuton，这是一个能够将神经元级别的认证器规范自动转换为张量级可执行程序的框架，使得无需手动编写张量程序即可开发新的DNN认证器。Neuton做出了三项贡献。首先，基于栈的中间表示（IR）和形状分析能够推断出正确执行所需的隐式张量操作，包括广播、维度扩展和规约。其次，特定领域（原文摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: Neuton框架能够自动将神经元级别的DNN认证器规范转换为张量级可执行代码，使研究者无需手动张量编程即可开发新的神经网络认证器。
